exact_draft_parent_fields_reinspected.label: Jacobins under the Directory: repeated revival, containment and repression
exact_draft_parent_fields_reinspected.meaning: Clubs, press, constitutional circles and parliamentary campaigns revived in successive crises from 1795 to 1799. Governmental indulgence and subsidies alternated with closure, harassment and repression when mobilization threatened the propertied middle course.
exact_draft_parent_fields_reinspected.stance: Pantheon, constitutional circles and Manège were distinct formations. Wartime emergency and anti-royalism created opportunities, but neither official encouragement nor electoral gains meant stable Jacobin control.

correction: The draft parent already spans repeated Jacobin revivals and repression from 1795 to 1799. Earlier lead historical notes referring to this as only a later-1799 parent are overnarrow. The 1796 mappings may remain in 3F2B when their phase and mechanisms are explicit; no rebind is required merely because the subject also contains 1799. Keep the substantive requirement to distinguish Pantheon/February closure, Police Legion/Grenelle and later Manège/Prairial events. Whole-record final repair review must test the explicit phase content rather than infer scope from shorthand labels.
